issues.evidence: The text mentions parents and wife only; no children.
issues.fix: 他帶著父母和妻子一起出門。

issues.evidence: The text says he emanates many brave men; it does not state the purpose (protection).
issues.fix: 這時，他變出許多勇敢的人。

issues.evidence: The text says the bodhisattva does not touch (realize) enlightenment; 'not in a hurry' turns a negation into a delay, implying he will soon do so.
The text says the bodhisattva has completely transcended the four maras, not defeated them.
issues.fix: 他們完全超越了四個魔王。

issues.span: 也不會只停留在空性之中
issues.evidence: The text says the bodhisattva does not abide in emptiness at all; 'only' weakens this.
issues.fix: 也不會停留在空性之中。

issues.evidence: 'Not meditating on signs'; 認取 is a hard word for ages 8-12.
issues.fix: 他在這段期間完全不去想著任何記號。

issues.evidence: The text says he does not practice/engage in signs, not that he does not seek them.
issues.fix: 也不照著任何記號去行動。

issues.span: 卻不會獨自進入超越憂傷的安寧
issues.evidence: The text says the bodhisattva does not touch nirvana at all; 'alone' adds the idea that he might enter it together with others.
issues.fix: 卻不去接觸超越憂傷的安寧。

issues.span: 以為自己能給出各種真實的祝福
issues.evidence: The text says arrogance arises because he has accomplished the various true blessings, not because he merely believes he can give them.
issues.fix: 有人成就了各種真實的祝福，就產生了自大。
